sounds.description: A fixture that proves the pipeline and the engine end to end; never in the production build.

origin.source: ffmpeg aevalsrc: a decaying sine at 880 Hz and at 1046.5 Hz

sounds.description: Light tap when you pick a cell, card or option that has no sound of its own. Provisional: candidate A (Paper tap).
A letter or digit typed in Daily Word or Code Breaker. Provisional: candidate A (Small paper key).
Backspace in Daily Word or Code Breaker. Provisional: candidate A (Paper swipe back).
Not valid: Not 24, not a trio, not a word, a Snap miss. Provisional: candidate A (Muted wood double knock).
Undo or start over (Make 24, Draw & Guess). Provisional: candidate A (Paper slide back).
Your short lockout after a wrong pick ends (Trios, Snap). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
Connection lost, or the room closed after a server restart. Provisional: candidate A (Felt thud with a low note).
Game over and you won or shared the win (rooms, and solo games against bots). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
You finished a solo puzzle (Daily Word, Code Breaker, Minesweeper, Make 24, Pairs, Trios, Snap). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
A solo finish that sets a new best on this device (plays instead of solo complete). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
Solo lost: a mine ends the run, you are out in Liar's Dice, or you ran out of guesses. Provisional: candidate A (Marimba with a soft fwump).
Someone joins the room (a burst of joins plays once). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba with a paper pop).
Someone leaves the room. Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
You press Ready, lock in a pick, press Done or choose your word. Provisional: candidate A (Rubber stamp).
Someone else is ready, locked in or done (a burst plays once). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
Your turn begins (Pairs, Liar's Dice, Gomoku, the drawer in Draw & Guess, each Doodle Chain step). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
Each of the last 5 seconds of a deadline you must act in; variant 1 is 5 s left, variant 5 is 1 s left. Provisional: candidate A (Woodblock, rising).
Time ran out on you. Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
A round or hand is revealed (one per round). Provisional: candidate A (Card flip and marimba run).
Someone else scored: guessed the word, solved the hand, found the word, cracked the code; one step higher per scorer this turn. Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
Everyone is ready and the game starts. Provisional: candidate A (Marimba motif after a paper riffle).
Game over and someone else won: a warm, kind cadence. Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
The drawer starts a stroke (very soft, rate-limited, heard by the drawer only). Provisional: candidate A (Pencil on paper).
The drawer clears the canvas (paper crumple). Provisional: candidate A (Paper crumple).
You guessed the word (bright ding with your points). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
Your guess is close (a little 'hm?' only you hear). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
Everybody guessed this turn. Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
Nobody guessed this turn (kind, never a fail buzzer). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
You open a cell. Provisional: candidate A (Paper press).
An opening clears many cells at once (one sound however many). Provisional: candidate A (Paper riffle).
You plant a flag. Provisional: candidate A (Paper flag pinned).
You lift a flag. Provisional: candidate A (Paper flag pulled).
You hit a mine: a comic pop-fwump, never harsh (others hear it muffled). Provisional: candidate A (Pop and fwump).
You pick or unpick a number card. Provisional: candidate A (Card lift tap).
You pick a sign (+ - x /). Provisional: candidate A (Wooden click).
Two cards snap into one. Provisional: candidate A (Card snap with a marimba note).
You made 24. Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
You skip the hand (page turn). Provisional: candidate A (Page turn).
A card turns face up (yours full, others' softer). Provisional: candidate A (Card flip).
A pair is found; each pair in a streak plays one step higher (variant 1 first pair, variant 5 the fifth and after). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
No pair: the two cards turn back. Provisional: candidate A (Two soft flips back).
You pick a card. Provisional: candidate A (Card lift tap).
You put a picked card back. Provisional: candidate A (Softer, lower tap).
A trio is found: three rising notes for you; when someone else takes one, the same softer. Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
A hint arrives (the 30 s hint in rooms, a hint you take in solo). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
You take the middle card (slap and chime; others' takes play softer). Provisional: candidate A (Card slap and marimba).
A new middle card is dealt (quiet). Provisional: candidate A (Card dealt).
Dice rattle in the cup at the start of a round. Provisional: candidate B (Kenney dice shake).

origin.source: Kenney Casino Audio: dice-shake-1.ogg, dice-shake-2.ogg, dice-shake-3.ogg

sounds.description: A bid is placed (yours crisp; others' and bots' softer). Provisional: candidate B (Kenney chip laid).

origin.source: Kenney Casino Audio: chip-lay-1.ogg and 3 more

sounds.description: Someone calls Liar (stamp and a 'dun!'). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba with a stamp).
Cups lift to show every die. Provisional: candidate B (Kenney dice on the table).
A player loses a die (it drops out). Provisional: candidate B (Kenney single die thrown).

origin.source: Kenney Casino Audio: die-throw-1.ogg, die-throw-2.ogg, die-throw-4.ogg

sounds.description: The 3, 2, 1 countdown before a level; the last count is higher (variant 1 = 3, variant 3 = 1). Provisional: candidate A (Woodblock).
A card is played on the pile: the game's only voice (yours full, others' softer). Provisional: candidate A (Card laid on the pile).
A card was played over a lower one: a life is lost (soft low thud). Provisional: candidate A (Felt thud with a low marimba).
A level is cleared (a calm chord). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
A clean level wins back a life (sparkle). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
A tile turns in the row reveal and is Right (brightest). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba on a tile flip).
A tile turns in the row reveal and is Moved (middle). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba on a tile flip).
A tile turns in the row reveal and is Not in (dull). Provisional: candidate A (Tile flip with a dull wood note).
A peg drops in after a guess: Right (brightest). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba on a wooden peg).
A peg drops in after a guess: Moved (middle). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba on a wooden peg).
A peg drops in after a guess: Not in (dull). Provisional: candidate A (Wooden peg with a dull note).
You toggle a digit note (pencil tick). Provisional: candidate A (Pencil tick).
The books pass to the next player (whoosh). Provisional: candidate A (Paper whoosh).
In the reveal, each entry appears (page flip). Provisional: candidate A (Page flip).
Someone hearts an entry (soft pop; bursts merge). Provisional: candidate A (Tuned bubble pops).
The album ends (closing chord). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba with a Kenney book close).

origin.source: Kenney RPG Audio: bookClose.ogg, layered with Zumpo synth

sounds.description: Your first tap puts a faint stone down (touch screens). Provisional: candidate A (Soft fingertip tap).
A stone is placed (yours crisp, your opponent's softer). Provisional: candidate A (Stone on a wooden board).
Five in a row (a chime that runs along the line). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
One more lost turn will lose you the game (a kind warning). Provisional: candidate A (Marimba).
